summaries.Romania: Romania's budget crisis deepens as the Finance Ministry reveals €4B in unpaid magistrate salaries while deficit reduction efforts continue; political tensions escalate over responsibility for the fiscal situation.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation focuses on aging egg restoration for fertility, eating disorder detection gaps in pregnancy care, and AI integration into clinical decision-making systems.
summaries.Tech: Black Friday reaches peak intensity with historic discounts on Apple products (AirPods Pro 3 at $100 off, MacBooks up to $400 off) while AI safety concerns mount at leading labs and regulatory scrutiny increases.

items.title: Ministrul Finanțelor anunță că deficitul bugetar a ajuns la 3,92% din PIB după primele 10 luni, cu 27 de miliarde de lei mai mic decât anul trecut
items.snippet: Deficitul bugetului general consolidat a ajuns la 3,92% din PIB după primele zece luni din 2026, în scădere cu 27 de miliarde de lei față de aceeași perioadă a anului trecut, a declarat ministrul Finanțelor, Alexandru Nazare, citat de Economedia. Execuția bugetului general consolidat în primele zece
items.line: Romania's budget deficit improved to 3.92% from 5.6% year-over-year, but massive unpaid obligations to magistrates (€4B) threaten fiscal stability.

items.title: Tunul magistraților asupra bugetului: Lia Savonea revendică peste 3 miliarde de euro plăți pentru judecători, iar procurorii solicită aproape un miliard de euro / Cum s-a ajuns aici

items.line: Magistrates' unpaid salary claims total €4B in court-ordered payments, creating a structural fiscal crisis that constrains government spending flexibility.

items.title: In a fertility advance, engineered molecular glue stabilizes chromosomes in aging eggs
items.snippet: Researchers engineered a protein system capable of restoring normal chromosome connections in aging mouse eggs, raising hopes of one day improving IVF outcomes
items.line: Researchers engineered a molecular system to restore chromosome stability in aging eggs, potentially improving IVF outcomes through biological intervention.

items.title: Pregnancy is the ‘perfect storm’ for eating disorders, but doctors keep missing them
items.snippet: Many women struggle with eating disorders before and after childbirth, but they often slip through the cracks of the U.S. health care system.
items.line: Eating disorders during pregnancy are systematically missed by U.S. healthcare providers, leaving vulnerable mothers and infants without adequate support.

items.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
items.snippet: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.
items.line: Nvidia halts server chip shipments to Southeast Asia as U.S. tightens restrictions on AI chip access to prevent technology reaching China.
